'''Tharston Kharl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked in [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Sarnus Refinery]] on [[Sarnus]]. He had a [[Tharston Kharl's wife|wife]] back on [[Telos IV|Telos]] but he carried on an affair with [[Dena Yus]], a [[biot]] created by [[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]] to spy on Calrissian's operations. Kharl died sometime in [[45 ABY]] after the refinery was [[Destruction of Sarnus Refinery|sabotaged]] by [[Vestara Khai]], a former member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] and an agent of Galactic Exploitation Technologies.<ref name="Crucible (novel)" />

Kharl was remembered by Yus as cheerful, supportive and gentle, even though he was obnoxious when playing [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="Crucible (novel)" />
